title: Bioethics Bench 200-case policy resource
description: Machine-readable Bioethics Bench cases and their reviewed policies. Legacy field names such as case_family_id and candidate_universe are retained for compatibility. Public/Expert/Framework policy type is assigned separately for a particular SACRE evaluation setup.

construction_standard.description: Legacy machine identifier retained for reproducibility. Current prose calls this the case-and-policy review model.

caseFamily.description: One Bioethics Bench case. The definition name is retained for compatibility with the original schema.

case_family_id.description: Legacy field name for the case ID.

scenario_audit.description: Editorial review of case clarity and adequacy.

candidate_count.description: Number of reviewed policies in the case.

candidate_universe.description: Legacy field name for the case's reviewed policies.

source_grounded_status.description: Review note about whether the current evidence supports a direct source-based SACRE evaluation setup.

expanded_projection_status.description: Legacy field name for notes about broader policy use in evaluation or comparison.

demonstration_richness.description: Editorial note about how useful the case is for demonstrating different policy positions.

candidate.description: One policy. The definition name is retained for compatibility with the original schema.

candidate_id.description: Legacy field name for the policy ID.

audit_source_mark.description: Legacy review flag showing that the policy had an identified external or framework anchor. It is not the public Direct/Inferred/Constructed sourcing label and it does not determine Public/Expert/Framework policy type.

audit_provenance_label.description: Exact scholarly sourcing note retained from the case audit.

provenance_class.description: Legacy internal sourcing class. Public interfaces collapse these conservatively to Direct source, Inferred from source, or Constructed.
